description: Vieu is a B2B enterprise sales platform that unlocks revenue hidden in your company's network. It maps your company's entire network, builds a deep relationship graph of every individual, and finds the warmest and fastest paths into target accounts. Vieu uses AI Graph technology to surface trusted ties from the public web—real human relationships that Sales Navigator can't show. Deals from warm intros and referrals close 3-5x faster with 25% higher ACV. Trusted by DataPelago, GoldCast, HP Enterprise, Hyperproof, Imply, Innodata, Meditopia, NetApp, Planisware, Rubrik, Seclore, Sickbay, SkyFlow, Socure, StackGen, SymphonyAI, and xflow.
